Highschool Hoops 🏀
Basketball game inspired by Kuroko No Basket
🎉 New rewards at 29k Likes, to claim in game goto: Tab Menu > Codes > Claim !

💥 Step into the court where flashy moves, competitive energy, and anime-style gameplay collide! Highschool Hoops brings a unique spin on basketball with fast-paced action, crazy badges, and stylish builds to Basketball.


🛠️ This is a demo version – bugs and updates are part of the process
⚠️ Stress Test in Progress – You may experience lag or bugs during this demo
📢 Join our group and follow our socials to stay updated and support development
